newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel weak, weak gas oil adds to losse.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel weak, weak gas oil adds to losse.

text.p: European jet prices continued weak on Wednesday as the effects of lengthy supplies were further exacerbated by sharply weaker benchmark gas oil futures, traders said.
Gas oil shed around $3 in early business after a bearish report for U.S. oil stocks triggered selling on crude and gasoline futures. Gas oil was dragged lower despite a bullish inventory draw.
Barges valued around June IPE +$18.50 fob Rotterdam, 50 cents lower, with cargoes off $1 at June IPE +$18/$20 cif NWE.
